scope: Read-only code review plus self-authored synthetic clock mutations; no economic backtest, market data, vendor execution or external requests.

checks.outcome_independent_ranking: No issue found: rank snapshot has no label argument; historical missing labels filter fitting after snapshot ranks.
checks.weighted_fama_macbeth: No issue found: per-week capitalization-weighted least squares, coefficients averaged over the fixed 52-row window.
checks.scaling_and_AICc: No issue found: training-only weighted means/scales, weighted residual MSE, 200-point fixed path; nonzero slope DF convention explicitly disclosed.
checks.positive_forecast_combination: No issue found: positive selected coefficients gate equal-average univariate current forecasts.
checks.portfolio_failure: No issue found: insufficient cohort, tied empty quintiles and unavailable learned signal raise rather than substitute a cash return.

findings.fact: Clock validation allows current_feature_time earlier than all fitted feature/label periods.
findings.limitation: This does not demonstrate unknown future-at-decision leakage: every historical label still precedes the decision. It fails to bind the claimed prior training window to the current snapshot.
findings.minimal_action: Model owner should require latest historical label <= current_feature_time and add a regression test; no model mutation performed by this reviewer.

controller_boundary.responsibility: Controller must bind feature/label snapshots to consecutive fully closed Jan1-anchored Liu calendar weeks, then bind current snapshot to those rows.
controller_boundary.interpretation: Low-level numerical model accepts abstract chronological rows. Full calendar verification belongs to the controller; this is not independently classified as a model defect.

limits: No economic or predictive edge conclusion.
